approvalSemantics.approvedAction: Authorize exactly one fresh Haiku successor formal automatic-activation Probe; preserve the consumed v1 result and do not authorize Skill changes or historical evidence relabeling.
includedImmutableBytes: The successor scenario.md byte sequence and its published SHA-256 value.
The successor protocol.json byte sequence and its published SHA-256 value.
The deterministic fresh Fixture tree and its published SHA-256 value.
The run_activation_probe_v2.py byte sequence and its published SHA-256 value.
The current using-helloscholar and record-experiment Skill trees copied into the isolated plugin catalog and their published SHA-256 values.
This manifest byte sequence, bound by the external Batch SHA-256 published in eval-activation-proposal-review-v2.md.
excludedMutableBytes: proposal-approval.json decision and replyEvidence fields, which change only after exact user approval of this Batch ID and Batch SHA-256.
activation-result.json and evidence directory, which may be created only by the approved successor Probe.

approvalSemantics.invalidationRule: Any change to the successor Scenario, Protocol, Fixture, runner, catalog Skill tree, or this manifest requires a new Batch SHA-256 and renewed user review before the Probe runs.

fixtureTreeHashContract: SHA-256 over each sorted fixture-relative POSIX path, NUL, file bytes, and NUL; .git, __pycache__, .DS_Store, and .hello-scholar-install.json are excluded.

proposals.businessGoal: 验证正式 baseline release-acceptance Benchmark 会在唯一一次启动前自动调用 record-experiment，保留完整进程证据，并通过项目支持的绝对 hello-scholar CLI 形式生成 runs/INDEX.md。
hardRejects: record-experiment has no successful Skill tool result before the benchmark command
